errors.text: The cited evidence supports Ga-associated phase-fraction changes and ferromagnetism of the BCC phase, but does not establish that Ga or increased BCC fraction raises coercive field.
Ferromagnetic behavior alone is not a sufficient coercivity mechanism; no domain-wall pinning, anisotropy, defect, grain-size, or interphase-boundary mechanism is specified.
The hypothesis does not reconstruct the target intervention or dual-phase fcc/C14 mechanism.
